purpose: single candidate full-process memory audit only
timing_note: This first-full-call audit includes monitoring subprocess overhead and is excluded from formal ABBA and speedup summaries.

output.digest_format: v1: named dtype/shape headers plus little-endian tensor bytes

process_memory_monitor.scope: only this process on the selected physical CUDA device; other processes excluded
process_memory_monitor.unit_source: nvidia-smi used_memory MiB, converted with 1048576 bytes/MiB
process_memory_monitor.sampling_note: Short peaks between samples can be missed. Missing/error rows are retained, never treated as zero. CUDA-init rows may precede process registration; required H2D-through-snapshot rows must be valid.
